visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a bright indoor room where a man in a white t-shirt is sitting at a white marble-patterned table, eating a meal of rice and vegetables with chopsticks. To his left, a Shiba Inu dog sits patiently inside a black mesh pet stroller, looking toward the camera. (2) The scene shifts outdoors to a paved plaza in front of a large, cream-colored building with yellow-trimmed arched windows. The man, now wearing khaki pants, walks toward the camera while leading the Shiba Inu on a retractable leash. (3) The man enters a lush, greenhouse-style cafe filled with hanging plants and vines. A grey tabby cat wearing a red bowtie is seen resting under a dark chair. The man places a plate of specialized pet food on a wooden table, and the Shiba Inu licks the food enthusiastically. (4) In a second pet-friendly space with green walls, the man is seen feeding a cat with a syringe-like feeder while the cat lies on a cushion. He then interacts with a black Schnauzer and a Corgi in a dining area, feeding them small bites. (5) The man enters the 'voco' hotel lobby, holding the leash of the Shiba Inu who lies on the floor near the reception desk. A female receptionist is partially visible behind the counter. Later, inside a modern hotel room, the dog jumps excitedly on a large bed with white linens while the man pets it. (6) A high-angle view shows a city intersection through a window. The final phase displays an event poster for the '2025 Chiayi Animal Carnival' followed by the man waving goodbye in front of the yellow-arched building.

A young male voice narrating with high enthusiasm introduces the theme of pet-friendly travel in Chiayi. The vocal delivery is fast-paced and articulated clearly over the BGM. (2) A 'Pop' SFX triggers as the scene shifts to the first outdoor location. The BGM maintains its upbeat major-key tone, while the narrator emphasizes the excitement of 'unlocking' three pet-friendly spots. Spectral brightness remains high with a focus on mid-high frequencies. (3) A digital 'Ding' sound marks the introduction of the 'Greenhouse' cafe. The narration continues with a warm tone, describing pet food options while the background music maintains a steady 125 BPM beat. Ambient indoor noise is extremely minimal, keeping the Signal-to-Noise Ratio high. (4) A subtle 'Whoosh' sound effect occurs during a transition between the rescue space and the hotel lobby. The narrator's pitch rises slightly during the mention of the 'voco' hotel, indicating a climax in the travel list. The music and voice overlap continuously without any silences. (5) The final phase features a percussive beat swell as the 2025 Carnival poster appears. The narrator gives a final friendly sign-off, accompanied by a bright stinger finish to the BGM.
